title: Noise sensitivity and Fourier coefficients
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $0\le\delta\le1$, and let $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\{-1,1\}$. Choose $X$ uniformly from the sign cube and obtain $Y$ by independently flipping each coordinate of $X$ with probability $\delta$. For each subset $S\subseteq\{1,\ldots,n\}$, write $\widehat f(S)=\mathbb E[f(X)\prod_{i\in S}X_i]$. Then twice the probability that $f(X)\ne f(Y)$ equals $\sum_{S\subseteq\{1,\ldots,n\}}(1-(1-2\delta)^{|S|})\widehat f(S)^2$.
